reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-30: Trevee treasury-backing-address docs still list the Ethereum Veda BoringVault as accepting USDC, USDT, DAI, GHO, and Sonic USDC.e, with funds deployed across external protocols under a published risk framework, and publish DeBank/Octav links rather than a dated asset-versus-strategy weight table. LlamaRisk independently describes the same multi-protocol strategy set (Aave, Morpho, Sky, Fluid, etc.) without a stable static split. Spot eth_call balanceOf reads of idle USDC/USDT/DAI/GHO on the vault address alone are not a full composition (strategies hold aTokens and other positions off the bare ERC-20 balances). The envelope therefore remains one explicit 100% mixed basket with knownUnknownExposurePct 100 rather than fabricating unsupported constituent weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Trevee disclosed Veda BoringVault backing architecture; independent LlamaRisk strategy inventory; on-chain idle-balance spot check confirming idle balances are not a full allocation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current balances by accepted stablecoin, lending protocol, and strategy are not published in a source suitable for a defensible static split; live wallet explorers change continuously and idle ERC-20 balances omit strategy positions.
